issue.title: Artifact-ref known kinds never repopulate after invalidate_artifact_ref_completion_cache bumps the generation
issue.description:
Proposed by phase beads sase-hp.6 and sase-hp.7 (epic sase-hp) as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP, where it was recorded as probable 'renderer/font drift' on a PNG golden. Verified while landing sase-hp: it is not drift, it is a functional regression in the artifact-reference highlighter, and sase-hp did not cause it.

SYMPTOM: 'just test-visual' fails deterministically on clean master (bb07bd865) with exactly one failure, tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_prompt_highlighting.py::test_prompt_artifact_ref_highlight_png_snapshot (1 failed / 569 passed / 1 skipped; 4399/1520532 changed pixels, 4328 material). Comparing .pytest_cache/sase-visual/.../expected.png against actual.png shows the golden is right and the code is wrong: '@plans:202607/design.md' and '@commit:sase@abcdef1' render in the vivid known-kind style in expected and in the subdued unknown-kind style in actual, while '@user:handle' stays subdued in both. Known artifact-reference kinds are simply never applied.

ROOT CAUSE: f164eee9a ('feat(tui): complete filtered ref argument completion', phase sase-ho.4) added a generation guard to src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/_artifact_ref_highlight.py. _warm_current_artifact_ref_known_kinds() captures self._artifact_ref_catalog_generation when it launches the warm worker, and on_worker_state_changed (line ~304) discards the result when result.generation != the current generation. invalidate_artifact_ref_completion_cache() (line ~352) bumps that counter and clears _artifact_ref_known_kinds_by_project, _artifact_ref_kinds_warming, and _artifact_ref_kind_worker_projects -- but it never schedules a replacement warm. So an invalidation that lands while a warm is in flight drops that result permanently and nothing re-warms. The same commit widened invalidation by adding ref source directories to the prompt-catalog token (_prompt_source_token 'ref_files'), which makes the invalidation fire during ordinary startup.

DIRECT EVIDENCE: a throwaway probe test (not committed) that mounts the prompt bar exactly like the failing snapshot test, with the suite's own patch_visual_artifact_ref_kinds stub in place, printed after mount: generation=1, _artifact_ref_known_kinds_by_project={}, _artifact_ref_kinds_warming=set(), _artifact_ref_kind_worker_projects={}. The worker ran to completion and its result was discarded by the guard, with no pending re-warm.

IMPACT: after any xprompt/ref source change invalidates the catalog, artifact references stop being highlighted as known kinds in the ACE prompt bar until some unrelated event re-triggers warming. It also fails 'just test-visual' and 'just check-full' for every agent on master.

SCOPE: make invalidate_artifact_ref_completion_cache() (or the worker-completion path) re-warm after it bumps the generation, so a discarded stale result is always followed by a fresh one, while keeping the staleness protection the guard was added for. Then confirm test_prompt_artifact_ref_highlight_png_snapshot passes against the existing golden -- do not regenerate that golden, since expected.png documents the correct behavior.
